name: typesafe-conformance
title: Align browser-with-typesafe with TypeSafe API conformance
description: Bring skills/browser-with-typesafe into conformance with TypeSafe's documented API and design guidance. Six findings from a code + live-Jev audit: (F1) HTTP 429/529 are treated as terminal instead of retried with exponential backoff, contradicting the API reference; (F2) the operation Choice criteria carry no rubric (criteria[op] = op); (F3) every target head shares one instruction that references an answer it cannot see, since questions are evaluated independently and in parallel; (F4) the target head's confidence is validated then discarded, so only the operation confidence gates; (F5) the fill helper is a hardcoded, non-configurable endpoint outside the skill's own provider abstraction; (F6) target heads have no escape option; (F7) the browser state is a flat string rather than structured. Scope confirmed with the user as P1-P5 including the two low-priority items, plus a re-run of the A/B measurement after the question-quality changes.
